This name is a reminder of the bond between the earthly and the divine, as we look up to the moon for guidance and inspiration.

It represents the serene and nurturing qualities of the moon, echoing the compassionate and loving nature of Allah. This name is believed to bring blessings and good fortune, invoking the protective qualities of the moon goddess in the life of the child.
